bar.name: Iron Morning
bar.text: On your first turn of each battle, gain a shield worth 50% of your armor.

bar.name: First Tremor
bar.text: Your first Tremor Slam of each battle Slows for 1 extra turn.

bar.name: Formed Up
bar.text: Your first Close Ranks of each battle costs no MP.

bar.name: Fault Line
bar.text: Enemies you Stun are Slowed for 1 turn after the Stun ends.

bar.name: Last Wall Standing
bar.text: When an ally falls, you are Fortified for 1 turn.

0.f1.name: Braced Stance
0.f1.text: Bulwark Aura on you +5% of your armor per rank if you did not Move last turn.

0.f2.name: Drilled Ranks
0.f2.text: Bulwark Aura also gives allies magic armor equal to 3% of your armor per rank.

0.f3.name: Tight Formation
0.f3.text: Bulwark Aura +2% of your armor per rank for each ally in it.

0.n0.name: Shield Brothers
0.n0.text: At battle start, allies in Bulwark Aura gain a shield worth 10% of your max HP.

0.r.name: Weathered
0.r.text: Bulwark Aura on you +5% of your armor per rank against area skills.

0.ea.name: Rooted Stance
0.ea.text: Each turn in a row you do not Move, Bulwark Aura on you +10% of your armor (up to +40%).

0.eb.name: Diagonal Guard
0.eb.text: Bulwark Aura also reaches diagonal allies.

0.ma.name: Unyielding
0.ma.text: With Rooted Stance full, you cannot be Stunned or pulled until you Move.

0.fa.name: Anchored Stone
0.fa.text: Bulwark Aura on you is 50% stronger, but you can never Move.

0.fb.name: Pledged Plate
0.fb.text: Allies in Bulwark Aura get 100% of your armor, but your own armor is 30% lower.

0.mb.name: Living Rampart
0.mb.text: When an ally in Bulwark Aura drops below 30% HP, it is Fortified for 1 turn (once per ally per battle).

0.v.name: Fortress Aura
0.v.text: Bulwark Aura evolves: at the start of each of your turns it also gives you a shield equal to its armor bonus.

1.f1.name: Deep Stomp
1.f1.text: Tremor Slam's Slow lasts 1 turn longer, 15% chance per rank.

1.f2.name: Shockwave
1.f2.text: Tremor Slam +5% power per rank against enemies already Slowed.

1.f3.name: Ringing Earth
1.f3.text: Tremor Slam has a 3% chance per rank to Stun each enemy hit for 1 turn.

1.n0.name: Rolling Quake
1.n0.text: Tremor Slam also hits the row behind for 50% damage, without Slow.

1.r.name: Fault Strike
1.r.text: Each Stun from Tremor Slam gives 2 MP per rank.

1.ea.name: Skull Rattler
1.ea.text: Tremor Slam has a 20% chance to Stun each enemy that is already Slowed.

1.eb.name: Aftershock Ground
1.eb.text: Tremor Slam leaves quaking ground where it hits for 2 turns: enemies there are Slowed at turn start.

1.ma.name: Third Quake
1.ma.text: Every third Tremor Slam Stuns the first enemy it hits for 1 turn.

1.fa.name: Heavy Landing
1.fa.text: Tremor Slam Slows for 3 turns instead of 2, but it no longer scales with Armor.

1.fb.name: Endless Tremor
1.fb.text: Quaking ground lasts 4 turns, but Tremor Slam deals 40% less damage.

1.mb.name: Sinking Earth
1.mb.text: Enemies on quaking ground take 15% STR damage at the start of their turn.

1.v.name: Earthsplitter
1.v.text: Tremor Slam evolves: it strikes a cross, its whole row plus its column front to back past reach, and Slows 3 turns.

2.f1.name: Bellow
2.f1.text: Taunt breaks after 3% more of your max HP lost per rank (25% → 34%).

2.f2.name: Second Breath
2.f2.text: When your Taunt ends, heal 3% of your max HP per rank.

2.f3.name: Thick Skull
2.f3.text: Taunt gives you a shield worth 3% of your max HP per rank.

2.n0.name: Cover Them
2.n0.text: When an ally drops below 30% HP, Taunt's cooldown resets.

2.r.name: Rally Cry
2.r.text: While you Taunt, allies take 2% less damage per rank (10% → 16%).

2.ma.name: Weathered the Storm
2.ma.text: If your Taunt ends without breaking, you are Fortified for 1 turn.

2.fa.name: Ironbound Oath
2.fa.text: Losing HP no longer breaks Taunt, but your allies get no damage cut from it.

2.fb.name: Hollow Roar
2.fb.text: Taunt costs no MP and has cooldown 2, but it breaks after 15% of your max HP lost.

2.mb.name: Refused to Fall
2.mb.text: When your Taunt breaks, its cooldown resets and you gain a shield worth 30% of your armor.

2.v.name: Bastion Cry
2.v.text: Taunt evolves: while it lasts you are also Fortified (damage taken -50%).

3.f1.name: Interlocked
3.f1.text: Close Ranks gives guarded allies armor equal to 3% of your armor per rank.

3.f2.name: Shield Chain
3.f2.text: Close Ranks gives guarded allies a shield worth 4% of your armor per rank.

3.f3.name: Linked Plates
3.f3.text: Damage Close Ranks shares to you is 3% lower per rank.

3.n0.name: Second Chain
3.n0.text: Close Ranks also guards the allies in your own row.

3.r.name: Linked Shields
3.r.text: Close Ranks gives you a shield worth 5% of your armor per rank for each guarded ally.

3.ea.name: Hold Their Weight
3.ea.text: Close Ranks shares 65% of the damage instead of 50%.

3.eb.name: Shield Toss
3.eb.text: Close Ranks also gives each guarded ally a shield worth 25% of your armor.

3.ma.name: Final Shield
3.ma.text: When a guarded ally would die, you take the whole killing blow instead.

3.fa.name: Chained to Them
3.fa.text: Close Ranks shares 80%, but you cannot Move or Taunt while it lasts.

3.fb.name: Loose Chain
3.fb.text: Close Ranks cooldown 5 → 3, but it lasts 2 turns and shares 35%.

3.mb.name: Steady Them
3.mb.text: Close Ranks clears Stun and Slow from guarded allies.

3.v.name: Phalanx
3.v.text: Close Ranks evolves: damage to any guarded ally is split evenly among all guarded allies and you.

4.u1.name: Payback Fist
4.u1.text: Fist Crush strikes enemies that hit you since your last turn first.

4.u2.name: Bitter Knuckles
4.u2.text: Fist Crush +25% damage against enemies that hit you since your last turn.

4.u3.name: Settle the Score
4.u3.text: Fist Crush always strikes the enemy that hurt you most this battle, twice.

4.r1.name: Plated Gauntlet
4.r1.text: Fist Crush's armor scaling 5% → 15% of Armor.

4.r2.name: Heavier Fall
4.r2.text: Fist Crush +1% damage for each 2 points of your armor above 40.

4.r3.name: Iron Meteor
4.r3.text: Fist Crush's armor scaling rises to 40% of Armor, but it strikes 2 enemies.

4.d1.name: Plate Hunter
4.d1.text: Fist Crush strikes the enemies with the most armor first.

4.d2.name: Can Opener
4.d2.text: Fist Crush +1% damage per point of the target's armor.

4.d3.name: Breaker of Walls
4.d3.text: Fist Crush ignores all armor on enemies with more armor than you.

4.l2.name: Pain Into Iron
4.l2.text: Fist Crush costs 1 MP less for each 10% of your max HP missing.

4.l3.name: Forge Again
4.l3.text: If Fist Crush kills, its cooldown resets.
